thag18.1:1.1: niṭṭhito Tiṃsanipāto. CATTĀLĪSANIPĀTO. Na gaṇena purakkhato care, vimano hoti, samādhi dullabho; nānājanasaṃgaho dukkho iti disvāna gaṇaṃ na rocaye. || ||
thag18.1:2.1: na kulāni upabbaje muni, vimano hoti, samādhi dullabho; so ussuko rasānugiddho atthaṃ riñcati yo sukhāvaho. || ||
thag18.1:3.1: paṅko 'ti hi naṃ avedayuṃ yāyaṃ vandanapūjanā kulesu, sukhumaṃ sallaṃ durubbahaṃ, sakkāro kāpurisena dujjaho. || ||
thag18.1:4.1: senāsanamhā oruyha nagaraṃ piṇḍāya pāvisiṃ, bhuñjantaṃ purisaṃ kuṭṭhiṃ sakkaccaṃ taṃ upaṭṭhahiṃ. || ||
thag18.1:5.1: so taṃ pakkena hattena ālopaṃ upanāmayi; ālopaṃ pakkhipantassa aṅgulī p' ettha chijjatha. || ||
thag18.1:6.1: kuḍḍamūlañ ca nissāya ālopan taṃ abhuñjisaṃ, bhuñjamāne ca bhutte vā jegucchaṃ me na vijjati. || ||
thag18.1:7.1: uttiṭṭhapiṇḍo āhāro pūtimuttañ ca osadhaṃ senāsanaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ paṃsukūlañ ca cīvaraṃ: yass' ete abhisambhutvā, sa ve cātuddiso naro. || ||
thag18.1:8.1: yattha eke vihaññanti āruhanto siluccayaṃ, tassa buddhassa dāyādo sampajāno patissato iddhibalen' upatthaddho Kassapo abhirūhati. || ||
thag18.1:9.1: piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto selam āruyha Kassapo jhāyati anupādāno pahīnabhayabheravo. || ||
thag18.1:10.1: piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto selam āruyha Kassapo jhāyati anupādāno ḍayhamānesu nibbuto. || ||
thag18.1:11.1: piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto selam āruyha Kassapo jhāyati anupādāno katakicco anāsavo. || ||
thag18.1:12.1: karerimālāvitatā bhūmibhāgā manoramā kuñjarābhirudā rammā te selā ramayanti maṃ. || ||
thag18.1:13.1: nīlabbhavaṇṇā rucirā vārisītā sucindharā indagopakasañchannā te selā ramayanti maṃ. || ||
thag18.1:14.1: nīlabbhakūṭasadisā kūṭāgāravarūpamā vāraṇābhirudā rammā te selā ramayanti maṃ. || ||
thag18.1:15.1: abhivuṭṭhā rammatalā nagā isibhi sevitā abbhunnaditā sikhīhi te selā ramayanti maṃ. || ||
thag18.1:16.1: alaṃ jhāyitukāmassa pahitattassa me sato; alaṃ me atthakāmassa pahitattassa bhikkhuno; || ||
thag18.1:17.1: alaṃ me phāsukāmassa pahitattassa bhikkhuno; alaṃ me yogakāmassa pahitattassa tādino. || ||
thag18.1:18.1: ummāpupphavasamānā gaganā v' abbhachāditā nānādijagaṇākiṇṇā te selā ramayanti maṃ. || ||
thag18.1:19.1: anākiṇṇā gahaṭṭhehi migasaṃghanisevitā nānādijagaṇākiṇṇā te selā ramayanti maṃ.
thag18.1:21.1: na pañcaṅgikena turiyena rati me hoti tādisī yathā ekaggacittassa sammā dhammaṃ vipassato.
thag18.1:23.1: kammaṃ bahukaṃ na kāraye, parivajjeyya anatthaneyyam etaṃ, kicchati kāyo kilamati, dukkhito so samathaṃ na vindati. || ||
thag18.1:24.1: oṭṭhapahatamattena attānaṃ pi na passati, patthaddhagīvo carati, ahaṃ seyyo 'ti maññati. || ||
thag18.1:25.1: aseyyo seyyasamānaṃ bālo maññati attānaṃ, na taṃ viññū pasaṃsanti patthaddhamanasaṃ naraṃ. || ||
thag18.1:26.1: yo ca seyyo 'ham asmīti, nāhaṃ seyyo 'ti vā puna, hīno 'haṃ sadiso vā ti vidhāsu na vikampati, || ||
thag18.1:27.1: paññavantaṃ tathāvādiṃ sīlesu susamāhitaṃ cetosamathasaṃyuttaṃ tañ ca viññū pasaṃsare. || ||
thag18.1:28.1: yassa sabrahmacārīsu gāravo n' ūpalabbhati, ārakā hoti saddhammā nabhaso puthavī yathā. || ||
thag18.1:29.1: yesañ ca hiriottappaṃ sadā sammā upaṭṭhitaṃ, virūḷhabrahmacariyā, tesaṃ khīṇā punabbhavā. || ||
thag18.1:30.1: uddhato capalo bhikkhu paṃsukūlena pāruto kapi va sīhacammena na so ten' upasobhati. || ||
thag18.1:31.1: anuddhato acapalo nipako saṃvutindriyo sobhati paṃsukūlena sīho va girigabbhare. || ||
thag18.1:32.1: ete sambahulā devā iddhimanto yasassino dasa devasahassāni sabbe te brahmakāyikā || ||
thag18.1:33.1: dhammasenāpatiṃ dhīraṃ mahājhāyiṃ samāhitaṃ Sāriputtaṃ namassantā tiṭṭhantī pañjalīkatā: || ||
thag18.1:34.1: namo te purisājañña, namo te purisuttama, yassa te nāhijānāma yaṃ pi nissāya jhāyati. || ||
thag18.1:35.1: accheraṃ vata buddhānaṃ gambhīro gocaro sako, ye mayaṃ nābhijānāma vālavedhī samāgatā. || ||
thag18.1:36.1: taṃ tathā devakāyehi pūjitaṃ pūjanārahaṃ Sāriputtaṃ tadā disvā Kappinassa sitaṃ ahū. || ||
thag18.1:37.1: yāvatā buddhakhettamhi ṭhapayitvā mahāmuniṃ dhutaguṇe visiṭṭho 'haṃ, sadiso me na vijjati. || ||
thag18.1:39.1: na cīvare na sayane bhojane n' upalippati Gotamo anappameyyo maḷālipupphaṃ vimalaṃ va ambunā nikkhammaninno tibhavābhinissaṭo. || ||
thag18.1:40.1: satipaṭṭhānagīvo so saddhāhattho mahāmuni paññāsīso mahāñāṇī sadā carati nibbuto 'ti. || || Mahākassapo thero. uddānaṃ. Cattālīsanipātamhi
thag18.1:41.0: Mahākassapasvhayo eko 'va thero, gāthāyo cattālīsa duve 'pi cā 'ti.
